summary: `delivery_git.py refresh-target` now refuses a Delivery that the Integration records as cancelled with `DELIVERY_CANCELLATION_INVALID`. Once the target had moved, it merged the target into the cancelled Integration and put a `target-refresh-v1` commit on top of the cancellation Review, after which `prepare-pr-creation` and `open-pr` refused and the cancellation could no longer reach the target through its PR. The refusal comes before any ref moves.
